cases.title: First launch requires privacy consent and completes onboarding
steps: Install the app without existing container data
Launch and verify that browsing is blocked by the privacy screen
Verify Continue is disabled until the agreement switch is enabled
Accept and skip or complete onboarding
cases.expected: The native home appears only after consent and onboarding state is persisted.

cases.title: A newly added quick site is immediately visible and persists
steps: Open Add on the native home
Verify OpenAI is the first visible quick site
cases.expected: The site remains first and visible after relaunch with the default six-site limit.

cases.title: Appearance and start-page controls are reachable and persistent
steps: Open Settings from the native home
Verify quick-site visibility, count, background, and manager controls
cases.expected: The semantic dark appearance renders and the selection persists.

cases.title: Native home remains usable in landscape
steps: Rotate the simulator from portrait to landscape
Inspect the browser chrome and quick-site grid
cases.expected: Primary controls and visible quick sites remain on screen without clipping or overlap.
